lauren_bishop: Anyone know if we can do true *zero retention* of prompt/response content for Hosted? NimbleHealth security is pushing back on 'we delete after X days' language. (See SUP-1842)

dev_patel: We can do no-content logging for gateway + tracing redaction. We still keep metadata for billing/reliability (req id, latency, token counts).

evelyn_hart: +1. Make sure were clear: no storage of content at rest, not no metrics. Also confirm support tooling cant display it (replay).

aisha_rahman: For customer wording: say prompt/response bodies are not written to logs or tracing systems; operational metadata retained. If they need a clause, use the security addendum template.

lauren_bishop: Perfect, thanks. Ill respond + attach retention-controls Confluence link and note replay disabled.
